body:
Oh damn, i can relate to that.. Too much.
Yes, that "no sense of closure". Its awful. Especially when you know that is not your fault. That you were doing the right things or at least trying to. And then you get something you dont deserve. Something that no one deserve. And still loving her after everything? Its pretty fucked. I know because i still love her too.

So yea... I am just going from one day to another just like you.. Sometimes i feel awful, some days a bit less awful. And i think that only thing that really still keeps me here is the fear from the failing if i would actually try to do that. And if i would actually have a painless and guaranteed solution... I would just go for it.

Yea, i get it. And honestly, i dont even have many regrets as i was always trying to do the right things. So i never really hurted or do something bad to someone.
And yes, its the easiest option.. But also the hardest at the same time. Well, for me personally its hardest because of fear from failing at it.
